source: BK4 printed p.77 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.83; ERRATA ER-23 (prose only); Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the wiring and the p.77 rule (two 3-bit numbers added, the high-order carry shown by light 3), with the p.77 procedure encoding (slide switch LEFT = 1, pushbutton pushed = 1; switches and pushbuttons 4, 5, 6 carry the 4, 2, 1 bits; lights 3, 4, 5, 6 read 8, 4, 2, 1). Only the 4 + 5 = 9 lamp reading is printed (A/IV-EXP6). Topology: relay 6 is never energised (6E/6- with 6C and 6F unwired), so its 6H-6J and 6L-6N contacts stay closed and the bit-1 carry-in is 0. Bit 1: relay 5 (5C/6K/6J, 6H/6X) follows pushbutton 6; light 6 (6A/5L) = switch 6 XOR pushbutton 6; carry C1 on 5T/6R/5V/6G = switch 6 LEFT and relay 5 (5H-5G-6S-6R); its complement Q on 5R/6T/6N/6L/6Z = pushbutton 6 up (6Y-6Z) or switch 6 RIGHT with relay 5 (5G-6S-6T). Bit 2: relay 4 coil (4F/5S, 4E on minus: E-F drive, indicator 4 dark) = switch 5 LEFT ? Q : C1; light 5 (5A/4L) = relay 4 ? pushbutton 5 up (4K/5Z) : pushbutton 5 down (4N/5X); relay 3 (3C/4G/5U) = relay 4 and pushbutton 5 (4G-4H-5X) or switch 5 LEFT and C1 (5U-5V). Bit 4: relay 2 (2C/3G/3N) = relay 3 ? pushbutton 4 up (3G-3H-4Z) : pushbutton 4 down (3N-3L-4X); light 4 (4A/4V) = switch 4 LEFT ? relay 2 off (4U-2N-2L) : relay 2 on (4W-2K-2L); light 3 (3A/M10/3K/4R) = switch 4 LEFT and relay 2 (4R-4S-2G-2H) or relay 3 and pushbutton 4 (3K-3L-4X). No path loops back, so each input set has one settled state. The switches are put RIGHT before power-on so the power-on state is 0 + 0, not the simulator's default switch position. The 500 ms advance before each expect lets the lamps finish their thermal transients; the page states no timing.

All switches RIGHT, no pushbutton down: 6X open so relay 5 out; C1 dead (6R off 6S); relay 4 on 5T = C1, out; relay 3 drive 4G open (relay 4 out) and 5V on dead 5W, out; relay 2 drive via 3N-3L-4X with 4X open, out; light 6 on 5N-6U with 6U off 6V; light 5 on 4N-5X open; light 4 on 4W-2K open; light 3 has neither 4R-4S (switch 4 RIGHT) nor 3K-3L (relay 3 out)
script.quote: In this experiment we will build a device which is capable of adding together two 3-bit binary numbers and displaying a result of not more than 4 binary bits. ... The high order stage of the adder is wired so that the carry from it is displayed by light 3.
